title: Output is the last vertex
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit in which every gate has distinct arguments and has exactly one argument if it is a NOT gate, and exactly two otherwise; suppose every vertex other than the output has positive fan-out. Then the output vertex is the last vertex, with index $	ext{size}(C)-1$.
hypotheses_covered: Each NOT gate has exactly one argument and each other gate exactly two
